findings.title: mapHandler stores entire ZEN output map but test expectation is ambiguous
findings.location: Design section 'Key behaviors' under mapHandler and test TestMap_TransformItems
findings.description: The test description mixes ZEN pseudo-code with expectation notation. Clarifying the test setup would improve readability.
findings.fix: Clarify the test description to separate ZEN configuration from expected output.

findings.title: ReduceSpec InitialValue JSON tag inconsistency with design philosophy
findings.description: With omitempty, round-tripping a spec with explicit nil will lose the distinction between 'unset' and 'explicitly nil'. This is acceptable since both cases result in nil accumulator.

findings.title: Test helper copyMap is shallow copy only
findings.description: The copyMap helper performs a shallow copy. Nested maps/slices will share references. For the test cases described, this is acceptable.
findings.fix: No change required — shallow copy is sufficient for verifying input shapes.
